title: convertStringsToChars
summary: Convert string scalars and arrays to character vectors.

gpu_support.notes: No GPU kernel is needed. Non-string values, including resident integer arrays and containers, pass through unchanged without provider access.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: [out1, ...] = convertStringsToChars(value1, ...) - Convert string scalars and arrays to character vectors.
behaviors: Convert string scalars and arrays to character vectors.
Supports multiple inputs and requested outputs; each input is converted independently.
String arrays with more than one element become same-size cells of character vectors.
Every non-string datatype is returned identically; cells and structs are not traversed by this function.
examples: [a,b] = convertStringsToChars("run", "mat") returns character vectors for both outputs.
